digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / LLM agent tool loop guard
propositions: The runaway guard's distinct-ratio window counts memo-served (cached) repeats as loop evidence because the guard sits outermost and observes calls before the memo layer answers them, causing legitimate re-reads of cached files to trip RunawayToolLoopError despite the memo layer making them free.

The guard must distinguish between executed tool calls (real work that needs bounding) and memo-served calls (cached responses that cost nothing), by having the memo layer report only actual executions to a shared ToolCallLedger, so the ratio arm computes over executed-only calls.
A served-streak backstop arm bounds pure cache-served loops (full windows of zero execution) without conflicting with cached repeats, distinguishing the trip reason via message text.

Five specific execution record sites in the memo layer must report when work is actually executed (non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature cache miss, read_file passthrough, first whole-file read, truncated-window exact-range fallback) to correctly populate the ledger.

The layer composition order (Guard→Memo→Steering) and completion-policy visibility must remain unchanged so the policy can observe all tool calls while guard and memo coordinate via the shared ledger.
